steps.operation: Clear the previous sequence result, owned event state and stale operator prompt.
steps.transition: Initialization completed.
acceptance: Left, middle and right results are initialized once at the start.
No prompt or product-event state remains from the previous execution.

steps.operation: Wait until _100B701 and _100B702 both confirm the product before requesting LEFT.
steps.transition: Both product sensors are TRUE.

prompt.english: Place the product correctly on the fixture
prompt.chinese: 请将产品正确放置在夹具上

acceptance: A missing sensor holds the step and identifies the missing BMK in EVENT_PART_DETECT_SENSOR.
The load-part prompt is shown only while product presence blocks progress.

steps.operation: Prompt for LEFT and wait for the LEFT one-hot fixture state, then recheck product presence.
steps.transition: Door is open, press is raised, _100B603 is TRUE, _100B601 and _100B602 are FALSE, and both product sensors are TRUE.

prompt.english: Move the fixture to the left position
prompt.chinese: 请将夹具移动到左侧位置

acceptance: An unsafe machine position does not release the move-fixture instruction.
Removing the product while moving the fixture prevents measurement start.

steps.operation: Write MeasurePsoEnum.LEFT while SqS_Run is READY and set Execute TRUE.
steps.transition: The subchain accepts the LEFT request.
acceptance: The shared subchain receives LEFT before Execute is asserted.

steps.operation: Wait for CheckSubChainDone and copy the atomic result to Result.Left.
steps.transition: SqS_Run returns DONE; ERROR is propagated.
acceptance: LEFT finishes before MIDDLE can start and Result.Left remains retained.

steps.operation: Wait until both product sensors confirm the product before requesting MIDDLE.
steps.transition: Both product sensors are TRUE.

prompt.english: Place the product correctly on the fixture
prompt.chinese: 请将产品正确放置在夹具上

acceptance: MIDDLE cannot be requested while either product sensor is FALSE.

steps.operation: Prompt for MIDDLE and wait for the MIDDLE one-hot fixture state, then recheck product presence.
steps.transition: Door is open, press is raised, _100B602 is TRUE, _100B601 and _100B603 are FALSE, and both product sensors are TRUE.

prompt.english: Move the fixture to the middle position
prompt.chinese: 请将夹具移动到中间位置

acceptance: Only the exact MIDDLE one-hot state releases this step.

steps.operation: Write MeasurePsoEnum.MIDDLE while SqS_Run is READY and set Execute TRUE.
steps.transition: The subchain accepts the MIDDLE request.
acceptance: The shared subchain receives MIDDLE before Execute is asserted.

steps.operation: Wait for CheckSubChainDone and copy the atomic result to Result.Middle.
steps.transition: SqS_Run returns DONE; ERROR is propagated.
acceptance: MIDDLE finishes before RIGHT can start and Result.Middle remains retained.

steps.operation: Wait until both product sensors confirm the product before requesting RIGHT.
steps.transition: Both product sensors are TRUE.

prompt.english: Place the product correctly on the fixture
prompt.chinese: 请将产品正确放置在夹具上

acceptance: RIGHT cannot be requested while either product sensor is FALSE.

steps.operation: Prompt for RIGHT and wait for the RIGHT one-hot fixture state, then recheck product presence.
steps.transition: Door is open, press is raised, _100B601 is TRUE, _100B602 and _100B603 are FALSE, and both product sensors are TRUE.

prompt.english: Move the fixture to the right position
prompt.chinese: 请将夹具移动到右侧位置

acceptance: Only the exact RIGHT one-hot state releases this step.

steps.operation: Write MeasurePsoEnum.RIGHT while SqS_Run is READY and set Execute TRUE.
steps.transition: The subchain accepts the RIGHT request.
acceptance: The shared subchain receives RIGHT before Execute is asserted.

steps.operation: Wait for CheckSubChainDone and copy the atomic result to Result.Right.
steps.transition: SqS_Run returns DONE; ERROR is propagated.
acceptance: Result.Right is retained without overwriting the earlier two results.

steps.operation: Return DONE and retain the three-position result until the next N000.
steps.transition: The command chain is complete.
acceptance: Result.Left, Result.Middle and Result.Right remain available after DONE.
ERROR or CANCEL clears the child Execute and any event owned by this execution.

cleanup: Set Wp100.SqS_Run.Execute to FALSE on DONE, ERROR or CANCEL.
Unlock and clear EVENT_PART_DETECT_SENSOR owned by this execution.
Retain Result until the next N000 initialization.

steps.operation: Latch MeasurePos into Result, clear the previous result, reset per-execution commands and reset CheckPressForce only at this explicit new-execution boundary.
steps.transition: Initialization completed.
acceptance: Changing the caller input after N000 does not change the active position.
No command or prompt remains from the preceding execution.

steps.operation: Validate the selected position as a one-hot fixture state and require the press in base position.
steps.transition: The selected sensor is TRUE, the other two are FALSE and the press is raised.

promptVariants.english: Move the fixture to the left position
promptVariants.chinese: 请将夹具移动到左侧位置

promptVariants.english: Move the fixture to the middle position
promptVariants.chinese: 请将夹具移动到中间位置

promptVariants.english: Move the fixture to the right position
promptVariants.chinese: 请将夹具移动到右侧位置

acceptance: An invalid enum value or ambiguous sensor combination does not release the step.
The displayed requested position follows the latched MeasurePos.

steps.operation: Execute FB_OperatorButton with _000S610 and flash _000P610 from Pulse500ms.
steps.transition: The operator presses the start button while the selected position remains valid.

promptVariants.english: Press the start button to measure the left position
promptVariants.chinese: 请按启动按钮，开始测量左侧位置

promptVariants.english: Press the start button to measure the middle position
promptVariants.chinese: 请按启动按钮，开始测量中间位置

promptVariants.english: Press the start button to measure the right position
promptVariants.chinese: 请按启动按钮，开始测量右侧位置

acceptance: The lamp flashes at 500 ms while acknowledgement is requested.
Leaving this step ends the button FB execution.

steps.operation: Start Wp100K101SafetyDoor.WRKPOS.
steps.transition: The door command is accepted.
acceptance: The command starts only with the press raised and _000K981_Y32 TRUE.

steps.operation: Wait for the safety door work position and both safety-circuit feedbacks.
steps.transition: Door work position, _000K913_Y32 and _000K912_Y32 are all TRUE.
acceptance: Loss of either safety feedback prevents measurement release.

steps.operation: Verify the common machine state, close the standard Burster connection and select Station.TypeData.Wp100.Burster.ProgramNo with one short *RCL TCP session.
steps.transition: Door and safety feedbacks are valid, all three Units are READY, and the Burster has acknowledged the program selection before EOT and socket close.

promptVariants.english: Measuring the left position. Please wait
promptVariants.chinese: 正在测量左侧位置，请稍候

promptVariants.english: Measuring the middle position. Please wait
promptVariants.chinese: 正在测量中间位置，请稍候

promptVariants.english: Measuring the right position. Please wait
promptVariants.chinese: 正在测量右侧位置，请稍候

acceptance: ProgramNo outside 0 through 15 is rejected before opening a socket.
Both parallel branches are released only after the Burster ACK; NAK, timeout or unexpected response returns a Chain error.

steps.operation: Copy the active TypeData upper/lower range into the Burster parameters and start SET_RANGE.
steps.transition: The SET_RANGE command is accepted.
acceptance: The values come from Station.TypeData.Wp100 and are converted explicitly to the standard Burster enum.

steps.operation: Wait for SET_RANGE and release Unit.Execute before any later Burster command.
steps.transition: SET_RANGE completes; command ERROR is propagated.
acceptance: Press-down and Kistler measurement cannot start before the Burster range is applied.

steps.operation: Wait for Kistler started, MeasRunning and no Unit error, then start Wp100K102PressingCylinder.WRKPOS on branch 1.
steps.transition: The press work-position command is accepted.
acceptance: The press branch uses its own return value and diagnostic step; it cannot apply load before Kistler enters measurement.

steps.operation: Validate and latch PressForceTimeout >2000 ms through CheckPressForce Phase 1. Copy KistlerProgramNo and start MEASURE on branch 2. Keep a larger configured watchdog, otherwise set its minimum to PressForceTimeout plus a 30 s movement/Burster/end-handshake budget.
steps.transition: The Kistler measurement command is accepted.
acceptance: The Kistler branch uses an independent return value; invalid timeout configuration blocks START. The extra 30 s watchdog budget needs field acceptance and does not disable standard timeouts.

steps.operation: Wait for the pressing-cylinder command started by N050 and start CheckPressForce Phase 2 at confirmed work position.
steps.transition: The press reaches work position; command ERROR is propagated.
acceptance: The simultaneous convergence cannot pass before the press is down.

steps.operation: Wait for Wp100A104Kistler.Unit.OutImm.MeasRunning.
steps.transition: Kistler reports measurement running; command ERROR is propagated.
acceptance: The simultaneous convergence cannot pass before Kistler is measuring.

steps.operation: CheckPressForce Phase 2 requires valid force >2500 N continuously for 2 s. Force bounce resets only the stability TON, never the total PressForceTimeout wait. A fault stays latched until an explicit chain boundary.
steps.transition: Force is valid and strictly >2500 N continuously for 2 s without a latched fault.
acceptance: At exactly 2500 N the stable timer resets; a 1.9 s rise followed by a dip cannot release measurement.
Repeated force bounce still reaches the total timeout. Timeout holds the press command state and logs position, reason and force; safety remains authoritative.

steps.operation: Recheck force qualification, copy upper/lower limits and ReadTemperature, and issue SINGLE_MEAS once. After the request, Phase 3 guards force even if single-step mode holds this action; do not retrigger the instrument.
steps.transition: The resistance-meter command is accepted.
acceptance: Exactly one resistance measurement is requested for this position.

steps.operation: Run CheckPressForce Phase 3 before checking Burster completion. Force <=2500 N or invalid force data latches a soft error and invalidates the result even if DONE arrives in the same scan. Only a valid completed command may be copied.
steps.transition: The Burster command completes; command ERROR is propagated.
acceptance: Result.Resistance is complete before the return sequence starts.

A force fault never advances to press-up or the next fixture position, and restored force cannot automatically clear/retry the failed measurement. Instrument requests are ended/cancelled while waiting for the operator.

steps.operation: Verify press work position and active Kistler measurement before entering the simultaneous finish branches.
steps.transition: Press is READY in work position and Kistler measurement is still running.

prompt.english: Returning the station to a safe position. Please wait
prompt.chinese: 设备正在返回安全位置，请稍候

acceptance: An unexpectedly ended Kistler command returns ERROR instead of releasing the finish branches.

steps.operation: Start Wp100K102PressingCylinder.BASPOS on measurement-finish branch 1.
steps.transition: The press base-position command is accepted.
acceptance: Press return starts from its own diagnosable branch.

steps.operation: Latch current Kistler verdict, program, force and stroke, then request EndMeasurement on branch 2.
steps.transition: The end-measurement request is active.
acceptance: Force and stroke are captured before the Kistler command is ended.

steps.operation: Wait for the pressing-cylinder command started by N100.
steps.transition: The press reaches base position; command ERROR is propagated.
acceptance: The finish convergence cannot pass before the press is raised.

steps.operation: Wait for final Kistler completion and add its final verdict to Result.Kistler.
steps.transition: Kistler returns its final result; command ERROR is propagated.
acceptance: The finish convergence cannot pass before the Kistler result is final.

steps.operation: Start Wp100K101SafetyDoor.BASPOS after the simultaneous finish branches converge.
steps.transition: The door base-position command is accepted.
acceptance: The safety door cannot open until the press return branch has completed.

steps.operation: Wait for the safety-door command started by N130.
steps.transition: The safety door reaches base position; command ERROR is propagated.
acceptance: The chain cannot finish before the door is confirmed open.

steps.operation: Return DONE, clear the atomic-operation prompt and retain Result until the next N000.
steps.transition: The one-position operation is complete.
acceptance: No operator prompt or active Unit request remains after completion.
Result remains available to SqC_Wp100_Run.

cleanup: Set FB_OperatorButton Execute FALSE and turn _000P610 off.
Reset the force timers, locked force event and per-execution flags only at the explicit chain boundary; merely restoring force does not reset the fault.
Reset the Burster program selector and close its temporary TCP session.
End and release safety-door, pressing-cylinder, Burster and Kistler commands.
Clear the operator prompt on ERROR or CANCEL.
Retain Result until the next N000 initialization.

testCases.title: Sequential LEFT, MIDDLE and RIGHT execution
expected: Only one SqS_Run execution is active at a time.
The three retained results correspond to LEFT, MIDDLE and RIGHT in order.

testCases.title: Product presence and one-hot fixture release
expected: A missing product or ambiguous position holds the active check step.
Every atomic start is preceded by a fresh two-sensor product check.

testCases.title: Command-chain operator guidance ownership
expected: Load and fixture prompts match the active command step.
The command chain does not replace atomic-operation prompts while SqS_Run is active.

testCases.title: Command finish and cancellation cleanup
expected: DONE retains the result and completion prompt until the next initialization.
ERROR or CANCEL leaves no Execute request or locked event owned by this chain.

testCases.title: CpStudio input and one-hot position contract
expected: MeasurePos remains a CpStudio-owned VAR_INPUT.
Only the selected one-hot fixture state releases operator acknowledgement.

testCases.title: Start-button acknowledgement
expected: The start lamp flashes while waiting and is off after the step or chain ends.

testCases.title: Safety-door close and feedback interlock
expected: The press remains raised during door closing.
Measurement starts only after _000K913_Y32 and _000K912_Y32 are TRUE.

testCases.title: Parallel Kistler and press measurement cycle
expected: Both groups retain branch diagnostics and convergence, but press-down is gated by Kistler MeasRunning before loading.
Each LEFT/MIDDLE/RIGHT operation requires force >2500 N continuously for 2 s; equality or a dip restarts stability but never the total diagnosis wait.

Qualification timeout and force loss during resistance measurement latch the soft error and prevent result acceptance, press-up and next-position release. Force loss wins over same-scan DONE, including single-step holds.
The Burster acknowledges the active TypeData program before SET_RANGE; range, limits, temperature selection and Kistler program then come from the same active TypeData.
Resistance, Kistler verdict, program, force and stroke are retained in Result.

testCases.title: Atomic guidance ownership and cleanup
expected: Only common sequential steps own operator prompts; parallel branch steps have none.
DONE, ERROR and CANCEL leave no active request and preserve Result until the next run.

traceability.text: Execute one SqS_Wp100_Run instance sequentially for LEFT, MIDDLE and RIGHT and retain all three results.
Require both fixture product sensors before each requested position and recheck them immediately before starting the atomic operation.

Require current IsInBasPosIn input feedback for safety-door open and press raised before each fixture prompt, independently of valve outputs; then require exactly the requested position sensor. The subchain also uses input feedback for physical positions; preserve Unit command completion and safety-relay interlocks.
The command chain owns load-part and fixture-position prompts but does not overwrite prompts while the atomic subchain is active.
On completion or cancellation release the subchain and owned product event; retain results until the next initialization.

Consume the CpStudio-owned MeasurePos VAR_INPUT once and require the selected LEFT, MIDDLE or RIGHT one-hot fixture position. Use IsInBasPosIn / IsInWrkPosIn for actual cylinder positions throughout the sequence and force monitoring; keep CheckUnitDone, ExecState and safety-relay conditions.
Wait for the physical start button while flashing its lamp with the Station 500 ms pulse.
Close the safety door only with the press raised and maintenance circuit healthy, then require both closing safety feedbacks.

Retain separately diagnosable start branches, but release press-down only after Kistler MeasRunning with no Unit error, so piezo OPERATE/START precedes loading. Join after press work position and active Kistler measurement.
Use the active Wp100 TypeData for the Burster program, range, limits and temperature selection and for the Kistler measurement program.

After confirmed press-down require force strictly greater than 2500 N continuously for 2 s within StationData.PressForceTimeout. Then run one Burster measurement and monitor force through completion. Timeout, force <=2500 N during measurement or invalid force data latches EVENT_PRESS_FORCE_INVALID, invalidates the result and holds the step without automatic press-up or retry.
Raise the press and finish Kistler measurement as simultaneous branches while retaining the final measurement values.
The atomic chain owns detailed measurement prompts only while active; parallel branch steps never write the prompt.
Open the safety door only after the press is raised and clear all active commands on DONE, ERROR or CANCEL while retaining Result.
